messages:
elena-cs: Hey team, customer reported SSO logins started failing after our scheduled cert rotation last night. Symptoms: intermittent login errors with 'Recipient mismatch' in the SAML assertion. Happening for ~30% of users. Need quick triage.

omar-support: Thanks Elena. Can you paste the raw SAMLResponse (base64) or the decoded fragment? Any recent changes on the IdP side?

elena-cs: Putting decoded snippet below (redacted):

```
<saml:Assertion IssueInstant="2026-03-15T01:12:34Z" Version="2.0">
  <saml:Subject>
    <saml:NameID>user@example.com</saml:NameID>
  </saml:Subject>
  <saml:Conditions>
    <saml:AudienceRestriction>
      <saml:Audience>https://app.redwood.ai/sp</saml:Audience>
    </saml:AudienceRestriction>
  </saml:Conditions>
  <saml:AuthnStatement>
    <saml:SubjectConfirmation Method="urn:oasis:names:tc:SAML:2.0:cm:bearer">
      <saml:SubjectConfirmationData Recipient="https://app.redwood.ai/sso/acs?relaystate=xyz" InResponseTo="_abc123"/>
    </saml:SubjectConfirmation>
  </saml:AuthnStatement>
</saml:Assertion>
```

elena-cs: The error we log: `SAML: Recipient does not match any configured ACS URIs for SP` (we also see `AssertionConsumerServiceURL mismatch`).

ryan-eng: Hmm, the Recipient includes a querystring `?relaystate=xyz`. Our SP metadata lists ACS URL as `https://app.redwood.ai/sso/acs` (no query). Some IdPs send the ACS with the relay state appended as Recipient which triggers strict matching. Which IdP vendor is this?

elena-cs: Customer is on Okta. They said they rolled a metadata update overnight. They also rotated signing certs. 

omar-support: Okta sometimes canonicalizes ACS entry differently. Two quick asks: 1) can you fetch the SP metadata the IdP has saved (the one from Okta console)? 2) can you confirm whether our SP metadata has multiple AssertionConsumerService entries or only a single one?

elena-cs: I fetched the SP config from their app settings. It contains a single ACS exactly `https://app.redwood.ai/sso/acs`. Their logs show they POST to `https://app.redwood.ai/sso/acs?relaystate=...`. I've attached a snippet in the ticket.

jess-ops: We have an option to accept ACS with querystring fallback in the SP layer, but it's off by default because it widens the attack surface (recipient matching is security-sensitive). For a short-term workaround we can enable `allow_acs_query_params: true` per-tenant. Would you like me to toggle for this customer?

elena-cs: Customer asked for a hotfix — they need logins restored ASAP. Please enable for that tenant and we'll revert after a proper fix. Customer company: "BrightMarket"; tenant id: tm_bright_775.

maria-privacy: Before enabling, confirm there's no relaystate abuse. Is BrightMarket sensitive? They have PII but are under standard enterprise contract. If we enable fallback, add monitoring and a short retention window for SAML logs.

ryan-eng: Quick root-cause theory: Okta may be constructing the Recipient from the configured ACS plus queryparams (relaystate or tracking). Some IdP metadata exporters can also include an ACS URL with `index` attributes or multiple endpoints and different Binding types. Another vector: the IdP rotated certs and the new metadata may have re-ordered KeyDescriptor entries which some SP libs mishandle (signature verification may pick wrong KeyDescriptor). But the current error explicitly says recipient mismatch — separate from signature.

saml-bot: [automated] New SAML error spike detected on tm_bright_775 between 01:10 and 01:40 UTC, 28 failed logins, error class: RecipientMismatch, alert level: high. Ticket created: #SUP-10298.

omar-support: Plan: 1) Enable `allow_acs_query_params` for tm_bright_775 (ephemeral) 2) Ask BrightMarket to update Okta app config to use exact ACS without querystring or add an explicit ACS entry with query param 3) Verify Okta metadata for KeyDescriptor ordering and ACS entries 4) Re-run cert validation. I'll own 1 & 3.

elena-cs: Please proceed with 1. I'm sharing customer's Okta support contact to coordinate step 2.

jess-ops: Done — enabled `allow_acs_query_params=true` for tm_bright_775. Pushed a temporary config change and added audit note. Rolling back scheduled in 24 hours unless we get confirmation from customer.

ryan-eng: I pulled the IdP metadata from the Okta metadata URL they shared. Snapshot:

```
<EntityDescriptor entityID="https://okta.com/org/0oab1234"> ...
  <IDPSSODescriptor>
    <KeyDescriptor use="signing">...cert A...</KeyDescriptor>
    <KeyDescriptor use="signing">...cert B (new)...</KeyDescriptor>
    <AssertionConsumerService Binding="urn:oasis:names:tc:SAML:2.0:bindings:HTTP-POST" Location="https://app.redwood.ai/sso/acs" index="0"/>
  </IDPSSODescriptor>
</EntityDescriptor>
```

ryan-eng: No explicit ACS with querystring present in metadata. So Okta is appending query when POSTing. Signature keys look fine, but there's also an oddity: the IdP metadata has two signing KeyDescriptors; our parser previously had a bug selecting the first cert always even if the signature uses the second. I'll open an internal bug to validate both.

omar-support: Good catch. Can you add the verification step to try both certs against the SAML signature? Tagging eng-runtime for a quick patch if needed.

ryan-eng: Filed ENG-SSO-4772: "Try all KeyDescriptor signing certs when verifying SAML signatures — prevent single-index assumption". Quick patch will be submitted as a config toggle for now.

elena-cs: Customer reports auth back to working after our toggle. They're asking for permanent guidance.

maria-privacy: Make sure we add audit entry and notify customer that we enabled a permissive fallback temporarily and reverted once they confirm fixed. Also create a short runbook for support to handle ACS-querystring cases.

jess-ops: I'll create runbook and add a scheduled revert in 24h and a follow-up reminder for backend patch.

omar-support: Summary for ticket: root cause: Okta app POSTs ACS with querystring; SP strict ACS matching blocked assertion. Contributing issue: IdP metadata ordering could cause signature validation edgecases (filed bug ENG-SSO-4772). Mitigation: enabled tenant fallback allow_acs_query_params=true (tm_bright_775) — temporary. Recommended customer action: update Okta app to include explicit ACS endpoint or stop appending query params, and confirm rotation applied cleanly.

elena-cs: Closing loop — customer PM said they'll update the Okta app tonight and confirm. I'll update ticket with customer confirmation and request rollback after they patch. Thanks everyone :thumbsup:

saml-bot: [automated] ENG-SSO-4772 created; priority P2; assigned to ryan-eng.

ryan-eng: I'll draft a small compatibility patch to try multiple KeyDescriptors first thing tomorrow. Will link PR here.

omar-support: Great. If anything spikes after revert, reopen this thread and ping @jess-ops and @ryan-eng.
